Discover our apart hotel place d'Italie in Paris, in the heart of the 13th district. Between the Asian district, for a touch of escape, and the Buttes-aux-Cailles, our apart hotel is located in a particularly picturesque area typical of the French culture. Your Paris serviced residence is located directly on the Place d'Italie, in the very center of Paris.

The flexibility of our offers allows you to make the most of your stay, whether you are alone, with your family, or with friends. Whether for one night, a weekend or several weeks.

Stay in an apart hotel Paris Place d'Italie

Our serviced residence in the heart of Paris

Citadines combines the privacy and comfort of an individual apartment with the amenities of a hotel. You can choose from a wide range of hotel services, according to your needs, but also according to your budget. Our studios and apartments are fully equipped and modern.

In addition to offering you a most pleasant setting for your stay, the serviced residence is ideally located, close to the many public transportation services available in Paris. 

Leaving your apartment, you can walk in a few minutes to one of the largest botanical gardens in France: the Jardin des Plantes. Get lost in the alleys of the Latin Quarter on the Left Bank of Paris, and take the opportunity to visit the Pantheon, the Lutetia Arena, the Rue Mouffetard...

Ease of access

Close to public transportation, our apart hotel Paris is served by three metro lines (5, 6 and 7) located 1 minute walk from the residence and which will take you to the four corners of Paris in a few minutes.

From your serviced residence, you can also easily reach the bus lines, access to the airport, train or bus station.

Our apart hotel in Paris with hotel services

Types of apartments

In our Parisian serviced residence, you will have the choice between several comfortable and spacious accommodations: the 18m² studio, the 35m² 1-bedroom apartment. The studios and apartments have all the necessary equipment for a good stay:

  • Flat screen TV
  • Double or single beds with quality bedding
  • Air conditioning
  • Fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher, microwave oven, dishes and kitchen utensils
  • Free WiFi
  • Bathroom with bathtub or shower
  • Electronic safe

Hotel facilities and services :

Our apart hotel Paris Place d'Italie allows you to enjoy the comfort of a furnished apartment, while benefiting from complete and personalised hotel services.

Included services

Any reservation of a studio or apartment, Citadines Apart'hotel gives you access to various services:

  • 24-hour reception
  • unlimited WiFi Internet connection
  • weekly cleaning
  • baby equipment (on request)

A la carte services

In addition and on request, you can take advantage of a wide range of services and benefits for your comfort:

  • buffet breakfast 7 days a week
  • laundry service and dry cleaning
  • extra cleaning service

Visit Paris from our apart hotel Paris Place d'Italie

Notre-Dame Cathedral

The Notre-Dame Cathedral is one of the must-sees during your visit to Paris. Although it suffered a serious fire in 2019, restoration work is well underway and the monument is once again open to visitors. 

Accessible within 20 minutes by taking the metro line 7 from our serviced residence Paris Place d'Italie.

The Butte-aux-Cailles

The Butte-aux-Cailles, a neighborhood of a few blocks adjacent to the residence Citadines Place d'Italie, is not to be outdone. On your way there, you will have the opportunity to discover the singular architecture of many of the buildings in this charming neighborhood. The 13th arrondissement is integrated into the Parisian hypercenter. 

Arrive within a 8 minutes walk from our apart hotel Paris Place d'Italie.

The Montsouris Park

Located in the 14th arrondissement, this very pretty, quiet and discreet park is accessible by a short walk. It is, indeed, not far from the serviced residence and is well worth the detour. 

Accessible in 20 minutes by metro with line 6 and within 22 minutes walk from our apart hotel Paris Place d'Italie.

The François Mitterrand Library

To visit the François Mitterrand Library is to access some of the greatest works published in France and which have shaped the face of the nation over the centuries. It is possible to get there by taking bus line 62 or line 64. 

Accessible in 13 minutes by metro line 6 from our apart hotel Paris Place d'Italie.

The Asian Quarter

Want to leave France while staying in Paris? Nothing could be easier. The Asian district can be reached within a few minutes walk from the serviced residence by taking the rue de Tolbiac and then the avenue d'Ivry. Discover the cultures of the Far East just a stone's throw from the apart hotel, strolling between Asian restaurants and souvenir stores. 

The Gobelins factory

In the 13th district, close to your apart hotel Place d'Italie Paris, the Gobelins factory is a tapestry factory more than 300 years old.

The typical architecture of the lights can be deciphered on all the roofs and all the engravings of the manufacture which strikes by its magnificence and the refinement of its authentically French finishing.

Access in 6 minutes walk from our apart hotel Paris Place d'Italie.

This Apart'hotel is situated at the crossroads of two worlds – exotic supermarkets and restaurants in Chinatown on one end, and a typical French scene on the other. The Butte-aux-Cailles village is filled with quiet cobbled streets, small houses and bistros.

The residence overlooks a tree-lined street, and is located in an important area just a few minutes from the Ecole nationale des Arts and Métiers, Pitié-Salpêtrière hospital and the Latin Quarter.

From the Apart'hotel, you can take a stroll in the Jardin des Plantes and Natural History Museum, or head towards the Bibliothèque Mitterrand (the new National Library). For a livelier atmosphere among the bistros, head to the Latin Quarter.

Three metro lines (5,6 and 7) deserve the Apart’hotel bringing you quickly everywhere in Paris

Discover our apart hotel place d'Italie in Paris, in the heart of the 13th district. Between the Asian district, for a touch of escape, and the Buttes-aux-Cailles, our apart hotel is located in a particularly picturesque area typical of the French culture. Your Paris serviced residence is located directly on the Place d'Italie, in the very center of Paris.

The flexibility of our offers allows you to make the most of your stay, whether you are alone, with your family, or with friends. Whether for one night, a weekend or several weeks.

Stay in an apart hotel Paris Place d'Italie

Our serviced residence in the heart of Paris

Citadines combines the privacy and comfort of an individual apartment with the amenities of a hotel. You can choose from a wide range of hotel services, according to your needs, but also according to your budget. Our studios and apartments are fully equipped and modern.

In addition to offering you a most pleasant setting for your stay, the serviced residence is ideally located, close to the many public transportation services available in Paris. 

Leaving your apartment, you can walk in a few minutes to one of the largest botanical gardens in France: the Jardin des Plantes. Get lost in the alleys of the Latin Quarter on the Left Bank of Paris, and take the opportunity to visit the Pantheon, the Lutetia Arena, the Rue Mouffetard...

Ease of access

Close to public transportation, our apart hotel Paris is served by three metro lines (5, 6 and 7) located 1 minute walk from the residence and which will take you to the four corners of Paris in a few minutes.

From your serviced residence, you can also easily reach the bus lines, access to the airport, train or bus station.

Our apart hotel in Paris with hotel services

Types of apartments

In our Parisian serviced residence, you will have the choice between several comfortable and spacious accommodations: the 18m² studio, the 35m² 1-bedroom apartment. The studios and apartments have all the necessary equipment for a good stay:

  • Flat screen TV
  • Double or single beds with quality bedding
  • Air conditioning
  • Fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher, microwave oven, dishes and kitchen utensils
  • Free WiFi
  • Bathroom with bathtub or shower
  • Electronic safe

Hotel facilities and services :

Our apart hotel Paris Place d'Italie allows you to enjoy the comfort of a furnished apartment, while benefiting from complete and personalised hotel services.

Included services

Any reservation of a studio or apartment, Citadines Apart'hotel gives you access to various services:

  • 24-hour reception
  • unlimited WiFi Internet connection
  • weekly cleaning
  • baby equipment (on request)

A la carte services

In addition and on request, you can take advantage of a wide range of services and benefits for your comfort:

  • buffet breakfast 7 days a week
  • laundry service and dry cleaning
  • extra cleaning service

Visit Paris from our apart hotel Paris Place d'Italie

Notre-Dame Cathedral

The Notre-Dame Cathedral is one of the must-sees during your visit to Paris. Although it suffered a serious fire in 2019, restoration work is well underway and the monument is once again open to visitors. 

Accessible within 20 minutes by taking the metro line 7 from our serviced residence Paris Place d'Italie.

The Butte-aux-Cailles

The Butte-aux-Cailles, a neighborhood of a few blocks adjacent to the residence Citadines Place d'Italie, is not to be outdone. On your way there, you will have the opportunity to discover the singular architecture of many of the buildings in this charming neighborhood. The 13th arrondissement is integrated into the Parisian hypercenter. 

Arrive within a 8 minutes walk from our apart hotel Paris Place d'Italie.

The Montsouris Park

Located in the 14th arrondissement, this very pretty, quiet and discreet park is accessible by a short walk. It is, indeed, not far from the serviced residence and is well worth the detour. 

Accessible in 20 minutes by metro with line 6 and within 22 minutes walk from our apart hotel Paris Place d'Italie.

The François Mitterrand Library

To visit the François Mitterrand Library is to access some of the greatest works published in France and which have shaped the face of the nation over the centuries. It is possible to get there by taking bus line 62 or line 64. 

Accessible in 13 minutes by metro line 6 from our apart hotel Paris Place d'Italie.

The Asian Quarter

Want to leave France while staying in Paris? Nothing could be easier. The Asian district can be reached within a few minutes walk from the serviced residence by taking the rue de Tolbiac and then the avenue d'Ivry. Discover the cultures of the Far East just a stone's throw from the apart hotel, strolling between Asian restaurants and souvenir stores. 

The Gobelins factory

In the 13th district, close to your apart hotel Place d'Italie Paris, the Gobelins factory is a tapestry factory more than 300 years old.

The typical architecture of the lights can be deciphered on all the roofs and all the engravings of the manufacture which strikes by its magnificence and the refinement of its authentically French finishing.

Access in 6 minutes walk from our apart hotel Paris Place d'Italie.

This Apart'hotel is situated at the crossroads of two worlds – exotic supermarkets and restaurants in Chinatown on one end, and a typical French scene on the other. The Butte-aux-Cailles village is filled with quiet cobbled streets, small houses and bistros.

The residence overlooks a tree-lined street, and is located in an important area just a few minutes from the Ecole nationale des Arts and Métiers, Pitié-Salpêtrière hospital and the Latin Quarter.

From the Apart'hotel, you can take a stroll in the Jardin des Plantes and Natural History Museum, or head towards the Bibliothèque Mitterrand (the new National Library). For a livelier atmosphere among the bistros, head to the Latin Quarter.

Three metro lines (5,6 and 7) deserve the Apart’hotel bringing you quickly everywhere in Paris

  • By Taxi: It takes approximately 30 minutes by taxi and costs about 40€ to get to the residence.
  • By Orlybus & Metro: Take the Orlybus to Denfert Rochereau, then take the metro line 6 to Place d'Italie. It takes approximately 45 minutes and costs 9.50€.

From Paris Roissy Charles de Gaulle Airport:

  • By Taxi: It takes approximately 40 minutes by taxi and costs about 50€ to get to the residence.
  • By RER & Metro: Take the RER B to Denfert-Rochereau, then take the metro line 6 to Place d'Italie. It takes approximately 1 hour and costs 10€.

From Gare du Nord / Gare de l'Est:

  • By Taxi: It takes approximately 15 minutes by taxi and costs about 20€ to get to the residence.
  • By RER & Metro: Take the RER B to Denfert-Rochereau, then take the metro line 6 to Place d'Italie. It takes approximately 30 minutes and costs 1.80€.

From Gare Montparnasse:

  • By Taxi: It takes approximately 20 minutes by taxi and costs about 25€ to get to the residence.
  • By Metro: Take the metro line 6 to Place d'Italie. It takes approximately 10 minutes and costs 1.80€.

From Gare de Lyon:

  • By Taxi: It takes approximately 5 minutes by taxi and costs about 10€ to get to the residence.
  • By Metro: Take the metro line 14 until Bercy, then take the metro line 6 to Place d'Italie. It takes approximately 20 minutes and costs 1.80€.
